blurb: DanceHaus offers a variety of dance classes for children and adults, private lessons, birthday party experiences, and summer camps. Classes cover ballet, lyrical, jazz, hip hop, acro groove, and more, with age-appropriate levels and attire guidelines. The studio operates a 10-month school year with a recital and seasonal closures.
extraNote: Tuition is for full 10-month school year, non-refundable · Registration fee $35 per dancer, $50 max per family · Recital fee $150 for first class + $100 for each additional class, billed Nov 15 · To opt out of recital, notify before Nov 15 to avoid fees · Withdrawals must be in writing before 1st of month to avoid charges · Missed classes can be made up within same season, subject to availability · $15 late fee after 10th of month; accounts overdue 3 months sent to collections · Dancers with unpaid balances cannot attend classes or performances · DanceHaus may close due to severe weather; updates via email · 10-month school year starting September 8, with summer camps
